text:
alex: Quick smoke run on fused RoPE + paged Flash variants. Observed 15-40% tail latency spike at batch=1..4 when kv_prefetch enabled. Root run: model=redwood/7b-fused, seq=2048, quant=4bit, kernel=flash_paged_fused.
maya: Hmm, can you paste perf numbers? p50/p95/p99?
alex: p50 22ms (baseline 18ms), p95 120ms (baseline 85ms), p99 280ms (baseline 190ms). qps dropped ~12% under steady load. :frowning:
ben: Any KV cache eviction or stall traces? Could be prefetch thrash with small batches.
alex: Attached flame + perf log snippet: /perf/1718003456/flame.svg
```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z kernel=flash_paged_fused batch=2 kv_prefetch=enabled stall_ms=45
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z kernel=flash_paged_fused batch=1 kv_prefetch=enabled stall_ms=120
```
maya: Try toggling kv_prefetch=false and set batching_policy=max_tokens=256.
sara: I ran that locally. Disabling prefetch restored p95 to ~88ms. With heuristic change (adaptive_batching.window=64) stable across seq lengths.
ben: Could be kernel selection misdetecting rotary dim scaling leading to extra memcpy/transpose. I saw memcpy spikes in timeline.
alex: Good catch. repro command I used:
```
rl run --model redwood/7b-fused --kernel flash_paged_fused --kv_prefetch=1 --batch_size=2 --seq_len=2048
```
maya: @ben can you dump a brief nvprof/cupti timeline when you have a sec? :thinking:
ben: Will run a short sampling job. Expect to check cudaMemcpyAsync on KV path and check if fused_rope code path does an extra transpose for rotary dims > 32.
sara: PR inbound to add a gating check: require rotary_scale_match for fused_rope kernel. Small patch toggles off fused_rope when rotary_dim != model.rotary_dim_hint. Also adding a fallback to fused->paged_fused if mismatch.
ben: Also adding metric: kernel_selection_mismatch_count and a sampling trace when mismatch > 0.
alex: @infra-bot can you kick a canary with the gating + batching heuristic tomorrow AM? Need to watch p95 and kernel_selection_mismatch_count. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-1718080000, results will appear in /canaries/canary-1718080000. Trace link for the failing run: https://internal.redwood/perf/traces/run-1718003456
alex: Thanks — let's ship the gating and the batching heuristic change to canary. I'll add an eval set to guard regressions and a short perf test in CI. :rocket:
